name: Strike
design_note: Baseline. Every other action is measured against this.

name: Ember
design_note: Starter. Hits RES; full power from the back rank.

name: Pierce
design_note: Ignores 75% DEF but slow. Wins vs armour only. S6.0 exemplar.

name: Flurry
design_note: 3 hits each rolling crit. Best keen target.

name: Execute
crit_dynamic: +0.65 at foe HP<=30% else crit forced to 0
design_note: v2.8 payoff is CRIT not power. Power flat and HP-independent.

name: Cripple
design_note: Slowed - 33% fewer enemy turns. Best non-heal rule.

name: Brace
design_note: Fast high charge. Fastest action in the game.

name: Vengeance
power_dynamic: 0.55 at full HP rising to 2.10 near death

name: Rally
design_note: Doubles charge rate. Highest charge gain.

name: Gale
design_note: All foes magic - safe vs thorns.

name: Smother
design_note: Dulled - cuts enemy MAG and healing.

name: Wayfarer's Oath
design_note: CHARGE - Kesh. Single burst. Highest power in the game.

name: Tideturn
design_note: CHARGE - RESOURCE/TEMPO. Buys turns deals nothing.

name: Last Light
design_note: CHARGE - REVIVE at 80%. Only full recovery in the game.

name: Sundering Vow
design_note: CHARGE - DEBUFF-first. Light damage strips DEF from everything.

name: Gravewind
design_note: CHARGE - TEMPO DENIAL. Slows every foe.

name: Reckoning
power_dynamic: 2.0 at full HP rising to 6.5 on a near-dead target

name: Bulwark Oath
design_note: CHARGE - CHEAP/FREQUENT. Low rank fires often.

name: Ember Glut
design_note: CHARGE - RESOURCE. Doubles own charge rate to chain.

name: Hollow Toll
design_note: CHARGE - SUSTAIN-AoE. Heals caster 60% of total.

name: Sundering Roar
design_note: CHARGE - Stone Ox. Enfeebles the party.
